svg.title: SMC local fabric and peripheral islands
svg.desc: smc_local_fabric and the register islands it serves. Its three initiators arrive from the input fabric with 32-bit addresses and 6-bit IDs: system (the filtered system AXI input), sep_in (the SEP AXI input) and local_in (the SMC's own initiators). Each address is rebased onto the local base, keeping the offset within REGION_SIZE, before the 3 by 5 AXI4 crossbar u_smc_local_xbar, which widens the ID to 8 bits, registers every port and answers unmapped addresses with DECERR; every initiator reaches every target. Target 0 is the CPU cluster front port (watchdogs, CPU control, SPM ROM and SPM, PLIC, CLINT and bus-error units) and target 1 the data accelerator control port (DMA and zeroer control), both AXI4. Target 2 is converted to 64-bit AXI-Lite for the 1 by 8 internal CSR crossbar u_smc_internal_axi_lite_xbar, whose targets in smc_internal_regs are the base configuration, alias remap, M-mode remap, Xvisor remap, inbound filter and outbound filter registers, the mailbox and the DFX registers. Target 4, the CLA window, is downsized to 32 bits, converted to AXI-Lite and then to APB for the DFD block in smc_internal_regs. Target 3 is downsized to 32 bits and converted to AXI-Lite for the 1 by 12 peripheral crossbar u_smc_periph_axi_lite_xbar in smc_peripherals, which serves the reset unit, misc, GPIO, AVSBus, I2C, UART, eFuse, telemetry, system timer, DTP CSR and I3C registers and the AXI-Lite extension port. AVSBus, I2C, UART and I3C cross to the peripheral clock. The eFuse registers have a second AXI-Lite port for JTAG.
svg.text: WDTs, CPU control, SPM, PLIC, CLINT, BEUs
